benchmark_definitions.always_long: LONG on every active candidate evaluation timestamp
benchmark_definitions.always_short: SHORT on every active candidate evaluation timestamp
benchmark_definitions.random: Random LONG/SHORT choice per evaluation timestamp with seed 42

decision_criteria.COST_SENSITIVE: Gross paired edge > 0 but net expectancy <= 0 under BASE cost scenario
decision_criteria.NO_INCREMENTAL_EDGE: Paired mean difference vs Always LONG <= 0
decision_criteria.OOS_POSITIVE_BUT_NOT_SIGNIFICANT: Positive paired mean difference vs Always LONG but 95% Bootstrap CI includes 0
decision_criteria.STATISTICALLY_SUPPORTED_EDGE: Genuinely independent OOS data AND positive paired mean difference vs Always LONG AND 95% Bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 AND net expectancy > 0 under BASE cost scenario

missing_data_policy: FAIL_CLOSED on missing assets, gaps > 4H, non-monotonic timestamps, or invalid OHLC

outcome_definitions.candle_indexing: Strict close-to-close forward return based on completed 4H candles

paired_comparison_method.observation_level: Exact matching asset and timestamp observation
